Kiosk · Wisconsin Creative · 2026-09-16

Reservation leftover pickup recovery

After David Saddler's WBB Practice pickup, the leftover tripod could be skipped with one tap and then checked out as a new booking. These after-only fixture captures show the three recoveries: leftover pickup stays an explicit secondary action, an equivalent scan can be swapped onto the reservation, and the hub asks to finish remaining pickup before a new checkout.

Kiosk leftover pickup

After-only. A matched before pair is unavailable: the true baseline was a live Video Office pickup of RV-0453, not a fixture, and this checkout already contained the prevention work. Captured on iPad (A16) simulator AD637556-84F9-4AEB-84C0-17457581CE72, Debug WisconsinKiosk, GT_KIOSK_SCENARIO payloads, dark, default text, America/Chicago, hour-snapped fixture clock. The simulator framebuffer was Portrait (820×1180 pt @2x); the mounted kiosk is landscape. These shots show the compact split, not the counter landscape layout.

Primary CTA stays Scan 1 More Item.

What changed, and why

Partial pickup stopped being the easy button

Was

With one leftover item, Confirm 4 of 5 was the primary action. That opened CO-0454 and left RV-0453 booked, so the next move was a new checkout.

Now

The primary CTA stays Scan N more. Leaving gear behind is a named secondary confirmation.

The wrong tripod can join the reservation

Was

Scanning the 755CX3 during pickup returned not in this checkout, with no swap.

Now

An off-plan equivalent scan offers to replace the remaining reserved item and stage the scan in the same transaction.

The hub pushes leftover pickup along

Was

Check Out Gear was available immediately, which is how CO-0455 was created 31 seconds later.

Now

Remaining pickup is named on Check Out Gear, and starting a new checkout asks to finish pickup first.

Verification

  • Focused source tests: ios-kiosk-partial-pickup-fixtures, ios-kiosk-reservation-pickup-contract, kiosk-pickup-substitute, close-remaining-*.
  • WisconsinKiosk Xcode verify passed on iPad (A16) AD637556-84F9-4AEB-84C0-17457581CE72, including XCTest.
  • These fixture screenshots prove presentation of leftover, swap, and hub dialogs. They do not prove the substitute/confirm/close-remaining mutations, authenticated web Close without remaining gear, or a physical kiosk scan.
  • RV-0453 live close-remaining and CO-0455 were not mutated.

Things to know

  • No trustworthy before fixture existed for leftover pickup, so this review is after-only.
  • Web reservation-detail Close without remaining gear was not captured in this slice.
  • Simulator was Portrait; mounted kiosk proof remains landscape iPad.
  • Local review: tasks/archive/proofs/reservation-partial-pickup-2026-09-16/review.html
